description: This home has such nice curb appeal and a great layout. Inside, the living room is super bright and airy with tons of natural light bouncing off the laminate flooring. The kitchen is totally updated with sleek cabinets, quartz countertops, a farmhouse sink, and stainless steel appliances plus there's a window right over the sink looking out into the backyard. Tile flooring flows smoothly from the kitchen into the dining area. Upstairs, you've got 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths, both upgraded with modern vanities and fixtures. The backyard is a huge open canvas it's just waiting for you to use your imagination to build a dream deck or whatever outdoor setup you can dream up. To top it all off, the location is perfect, as you're right by McClatchy Park, the UC Davis Med Center, and all the cool shops, coffee spots, breweries, and boutiques around Oak Park and Broadway.
